pattern_description: Surge in 'Overdraft fee' complaints during 2025-05-18 (31 complaints, +46% over baseline, Z=2.5).
observed_facts: Total empirical complaints matching pattern criteria: 434.
Primary submission channel: Web (39.2% of pattern records).
evidence_summary: Analyzed 434 complaints. Primary channel: Web. Sentiment: 66% Negative. Representative IDs: SYN-CC-000300, SYN-CC-000525, SYN-CC-000553.
possible_root_cause: [Hypothesis - Operational] A recent system update or processing batch run on or around 2025-05-18 may have introduced a discrepancy in how available balance calculations or transaction posting orders are executed, leading to unexpected overdraft fee assessments despite customers believing funds were sufficient.
recommended_investigation:
1. Audit the core banking transaction processing logs and batch posting schedules for May 17-18, 2025, to identify any changes in transaction re-ordering or ledger settlement logic.
2. Review recent code deployments and configuration changes in the automated fee-assessment engine to check for logic flaws regarding available balance definitions.
3. Pull a random sample of the 31 surging complaints to cross-reference customer ledger timestamps against support interaction logs to verify if pending transaction visibility discrepancies caused the disputed fees.
methodological_disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: The possible root cause stated above is a theoretical hypothesis generated from statistical patterns and complaint narratives. It has NOT been verified by internal systems audits and must be confirmed through targeted technical logs review.
